mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO trade_calendar ( market_code, trade_date, is_trading_day, day_type, holiday_name, source_title, source_url, is_manual_adjusted, remark ) VALUES
( #{item.marketCode}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.isTradingDay}, #{item.dayType}, #{item.holidayName}, #{item.sourceTitle}, #{item.sourceUrl}, #{item.isManualAdjusted}, #{item.remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, market_code, trade_date, is_trading_day, day_type, holiday_name, source_title, source_url, is_manual_adjusted, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM trade_calendar WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate}
SELECT trade_date FROM trade_calendar WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND trade_date < #{tradeDate} AND is_trading_day = 1 ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, 1
SELECT trade_date FROM trade_calendar WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND trade_date > #{tradeDate} AND is_trading_day = 1 ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT #{offset}, 1
